_comment: Copy to ~/.osh/workspace-audit/tenants.json (or pass --tenants <path>) and fill in. Keep the real file out of the repository: it names your clients. customer_id is required: the run stops before collecting anything if gam info domain answers with a different one. gamcfgdir is the GAM config folder for that tenant (GAMCFGDIR); leave it out to use GAM's default. break_glass lists emergency super admins that are deliberately never signed into: they are left out of the dormancy checks and named in the report.
